counterexamples.field_or_glossary: render_decision.zones.aliases[you-key-line].role = 'the one in column 4: the whole four-in-a-row line you are playing for'
counterexamples.evidence: The line is row-6 horizontal across columns 4-7; column 4 is full (X,O,X,X,O,X bottom-to-top) and holds no four. The role's disambiguator ('the one in column N' = the line's leftmost column) reads to a player as a location, and 2 of 3 runs echoed it as 'four-in-a-row line in column 4' / 'row of four in column 4'.
Run 1 omitted the required you-key-line handle entirely; production would have retried, so the omission is an eval artifact. It is also the only run that avoided the false column-4 phrasing.
